title: Repot a small cactus one size up: free its bound root ball, lift it only by its collar, set it at the same depth
instruction: This cactus has outgrown its pot. Move it into the bigger pot: upright, in the middle, on the mix, with the top of its root ball 1 to 2 cm below the rim, the same depth as before. Handle the cactus only by the foam collar round it, and don't pull the root ball against the old pot's grip. Then let go and move clear.
context: Helping people repot a houseplant that has outgrown its pot is everyday household help: about two-thirds of US adults keep a houseplant, and small cacti are among the commonest. Root-bound plants stop thriving, yet repotting is fiddly and a cactus cannot be held by hand, so it is a chore many people put off or find hard, especially with weak grip or limited mobility. Done right, as the extension method says, the nursery pot is squeezed to free the ball rather than pulling the plant (Gardener's Path), the cactus is handled through a band or tongs (Univ. of Arizona AZ1376; Chicago Botanic Garden), and it is planted at the same depth.
setup: Positions in m from the arm bases' midpoint, x forward, y left. Grey 3 mm rubber mat, 0.30 x 0.56 m, centred at (0.35, 0.03). Old pot: Teku VCG 9, round black PP, 9.0 cm rim, 6.8 cm tall, 0.29 L, thin wall, upright at (0.35, -0.06). In it a golden barrel cactus (Echinocactus grusonii), 5.5-6.5 cm across the spine tips, 5-7 cm tall; root ball 8.0 cm top, 6.8 cm base, 5.5 cm tall, about 0.18 kg, face 1.2 cm below the rim, push-out 12-20 N. Collar: 30 mm band of 4 mm EVA foam taped round the body, 1.2-4.2 cm above the soil. New pot: HC 4.00 in. Standard Thinwall, black PP, 10.2 cm rim, 8.9 cm tall, at (0.35, 0.13), with cactus mix firmed level 2.0 cm deep. Neoprene pad covers.
scoring: Ruler at 4 points on the new rim (depth = mean, tilt = largest difference, off-centre = half the larger opposite gap difference), video, gripper log. Home: grippers within 3 cm of start, 3 cm clear of all objects, 1 s. Freed: old pot wall pressed in 3 mm, 4.5 cm up, on two opposite sides, 1 s. 1.0 when home: ball whole on the mix in the new pot, depth 1.0-2.0 cm, off-centre under 0.4 cm, tilt under 0.8 cm. 0.75 when home: same, depth 0.5-2.5 cm, off-centre under 0.7 cm, tilt under 1.5 cm. 0.5 when home: ball whole, out of the old pot, tilted under 30 deg. 0.25: freed, ball whole and risen 1 cm, not held. 0 if a gripper or arm touches the cactus off the collar; a fingertip touches the soil or the ball outside the old pot; the ball rises 1 cm before freed; the old pot lifts 2 cm; the cactus falls 3 cm or tilts past 30 deg; the new pot moves 2 cm or tips past 15 deg; anything leaves the table; any other end state.
reset_notes: Plants are bought already rooted (no growing). A golden barrel tolerates repeated lifting; retire it after 20 trials, a broken spine cluster, or a ball 15 g lighter than at first. Lift the cactus by its collar (left on between trials, never re-taped), slide the ball back into the old pot, stand it on a kitchen scale and press the soil face home with flat fingers either side of the body to 3-4 kg for 5 s. Once per plant and every 5 trials, check the grip: push-out with a 12 mm dowel through a drain hole (pot on its rim on two blocks on the scale) peaks at 1.2-2.0 kg; after pressing the wall in 3 mm each side, under 0.3 kg; press home again. The base layer is dry cactus mix, firmed to 2.0 cm with a 7 cm disc and topped up after each trial. Grippers touch only the old pot and the collar, never soil; check the pad covers for spine punctures.
fidelity: Cactus: one rigid body on its ball. The old pot's wall is four quarter panels hinged at the base on springs set to move in 3 mm, 4.5 cm up, under 20 N, as the real pot measures; inward flex stops near 4 mm, where the real wall meets the ball. The roots' grip is a bond freed once two opposite panels are pressed in 3 mm for 1 s; unfreed, it holds to a 15 N pull. Sim ball 7.5 cm across the top (real 8.0). Base layer a rigid disc; no loose mix; a 3 cm drop stands for a broken ball.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (valid run); scripted demo: 1.0 (585 steps)
